ipos.name: Jio Platforms
ipos.about: Founded in 2019, Jio Platforms is a leading digital service provider and a subsidiary of Reliance Industries. MyJio, JioCinema, JioSaavn, and Reliance Jio Infocomm are some of the digital service applications offered by Jio Platforms. Over the years, Jio Platforms has served over 524 million people with its advanced connectivity and digital services. Its main aim is to offer affordable internet connectivity, digital entertainment, gaming, cloud storage, smart home solutions, and AI-enabled digital services to every household. Jio offers high-quality digital solutions at an affordable price point. Its ecosystem includes platforms such as MyJio, JioTV+, JioSaavn, JioGames, and JioAICloud. Moreover, the firm also offers services like enterprise connectivity, cloud solutions, IoT services, unified communications platforms, managed services, security solutions, and private 5G offerings serving enterprise customers, including banking, utilities, transportation, manufacturing, government, and information technology sectors.

ipos.name: Paras Healthcare
ipos.about: Paras Healthcare Limited, founded in 1987, is the fifth-largest healthcare provider across North India, Bihar, and Jharkhand. As of now, the company runs 8 hospitals under the Paras Health brand in North India, including Gurugram, Haryana, Patna, Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, Udaipur, Rajasthan, Jharkhand, and Jammu and Kashmir. The main goal of the company is to offer high-quality and affordable healthcare in tier 2 and tier 3 cities. Heart care, cancer treatment, brain and nerve care, digestive health, and bone and joint replacement are the variety of medical services the company offers. Paras Healthcare has established its presence among customers by having 18 years of experience in the healthcare industry. In March 2022, the company had a bed capacity of 1250 beds, which expanded to 2135 in March 2024. Moreover, the company consists of a dedicated team of 1091 doctors and 1509 nurses throughout its hospitals as of March 31, 2024.

ipos.name: Bonfiglioli Transmissions
ipos.about: Bonfiglioli Transmissions is one of the leading Indian companies providing mechanical and electro-mechanical power transmission solutions. The company makes and sells high-precision, mission-critical gearboxes and drive systems serving various industries. Its product portfolio includes low, medium and heavy-duty gear motors and gearboxes in torque capacities ranging from 13 Nm to 1,400 kNm; helical, bevel, planetary, and worm gearboxes and gear motors; electric motors; variable frequency drives, servo motors, and drives; and precision drives for robotics & automation solutions. Its products are used widely in Industry and Automation Solutions, Off-Highway Mobility, and the wind industry. Bonfiglioli Transmissions serves 3 main market segments, including Industry and Automation Solutions, Off-Highway Mobility, and the Wind Industry. Moreover, the firm operates 3 manufacturing facilities: two in Tamil Nadu and one in Maharashtra, together producing over 330,000 gear motors and gearboxes.

ipos.name: Tonbo Imaging
ipos.about: Tonbo Imaging India, founded in December 2003, is a growing global defence electronics original equipment manufacturer (OEM). The firm is involved in the design, development, and manufacturing of advanced electro-optic, infrared (EO/IR), embedded vision, communication, guidance, and surveillance systems for defence and security use. Its product portfolio includes thermal imaging systems, weapon sights, missile seekers, fire control systems, missile guidance systems, targeting systems, and handheld thermal imaging devices. Its products cater to defence and security organizations across 24 countries with over 28,000 field-deployed systems. Moreover, it is India’s largest manufacturer of thermal imaging systems for government and defence agencies. Furthermore, its products are developed using its own technology and are free from ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations) restrictions.

ipos.name: Zetwerk
ipos.about: Incorporated in 2018, Zetwerk is one of the growing Indian B2B (business-to-business) manufacturing companies that uses technology to supply various types of industrial products to various industries such as electronics, renewable energy, aerospace and defence, capital goods, and precision manufacturing. It is a Bengaluru-based firm that follows an asset-light model and offers end-to-end solutions, such as design, supplier matching, quality control, and logistics. The firm basically helps businesses get their electronics industrial products manufactured, filling the gap between businesses and manufacturers. The firm has a presence in over 25 countries and a network of 10,000+ suppliers and 1,100+ customers. Moreover, Zetwerk operates 20+ manufacturing facilities across India, the United States, and Mexico.

ipos.name: Sahajanand Medical
ipos.about: Incorporated in 2001, Sahajanand Medical Technologies is a medical device firm that focuses on Class III and Class C/D devices, mainly working in the fields of vascular and structural heart intervention. The company was the first globally to achieve CE certification for a drug-eluting stent (DES) with a biodegradable polymer, Infinnium. Its product range is divided into 3 main categories: Vascular Intervention (VI), Structural Heart (SH), and other products. Sahajanand operates two R&D centers, one in India & one in Thailand, backed by a team of 102 professionals such as biomedical engineers and clinical research specialists. Moreover, its key products such as Supraflex Cruz (DES), Hydra (TAVI), and Cocoon (Occluders) are backed by 72 clinical studies and are widely known in over 76 countries across Europe, Asia, and other regions.

ipos.name: Fusion CX
ipos.about: Fusion CX is one of the well-known customer experience (“CX”) service-providing companies. They are famous for offering high-end, complex, and integrated CX services across multiple channels, including voice, email, chat, social media, and messaging. Fusion CX offers a wide range of services, including customer acquisition, customer service, order fulfillment support, payment and collections services, customer retention, technical support, and digital solutions. Its services tailored to serve a wide range of industries such as telecom and utilities, healthcare and life sciences, hi-tech and technology (HTT), banking and finance (BFSI), and retail, and it has established a strong presence in these sectors. Moreover, as of 2024, the firm operates 40 delivery centers across 15 countries and provides services in 28 languages, supported by 10,520 CX professionals and a 12,323-strong field workforce.

ipos.name: HD Fire Protect
ipos.about: Founded in April 1997, HD Fire Protect is one of the leading manufacturers and suppliers of fire protection equipment and systems, including Water-based, Foam-based, and Gas-based fire suppression solutions. The firm provides a wide range of fire-protection products and systems, divided into 8 main categories, including sprinklers, alarm valves and accessories, deluge valves and systems, foam equipment and suppression systems, monitors and nozzles, water spray nozzles, custom-engineered systems, and gas suppression systems. Its product range serves a wide range of industries such as industrial, residential, and commercial applications, including oil and gas, refining and petrochemicals, power and energy, heavy engineering, aerospace, pharmaceuticals, data centres, hospitality, healthcare, and other sectors. The firm has over 30 years of experience exporting its products to over 90 countries. HD Fire Protect operates its manufacturing facilities in Jalgaon and Thane, Maharashtra, spanning 8.50 acres of land.

ipos.name: Shellz India
ipos.about: Shellz India is one of the leading manufacturers, marketers, and suppliers of a wide range of confectionery products, food, and bakery ingredients in India. Its product range includes a total of 250 types of products across various categories, such as chocolate-based products, jellies, baked treats, and other confectionery formats. Moreover, the firm also manufactures and supplies food and bakery ingredients serving urban and semi-urban markets, as well as smaller towns and rural areas. Shellz markets its products under 2 brands: Hugs and Tosca. Its Hugs brand offers 4 major product categories: baked treats, chocolate-based confectionery, jellies, and pan-and-sugar confectionery. While the Tosca brand offers premium products at a high price, it mostly serves urban consumers.

ipos.name: Ravita Engineering
ipos.about: Incorporated in December 2007, Ravita Engineering Services is an engineering solutions firm that is involved in the Engineering, Procurement, Installation and Commissioning (“EPIC”) of heating, ventilation and air-conditioning (“HVAC”) systems, central air-conditioning solutions, airflow systems, chiller plants, industrial compressors, cooling equipment and other related electromechanical equipment on a turnkey basis. The Company operates across three primary business segments: onshore, offshore, and data centre. The firm undertakes onshore activities across key regions including Gujarat, Maharashtra, Odisha, and Karnataka. Offshore operations occur at rigs, platforms, and marine installations in India’s territorial waters.

ipos.name: Vaibhav Vyapaar
ipos.about: Founded in 2009, Vaibhav Vyapaar is a non-banking financial company (NBFC) that offers a wide range of financial services to salaried and self-employed individuals via its digital lending platform. Its product range includes unsecured personal loans through its mobile app, LoanFront – Personal Loan App. The app offers complete digital loan origination, underwriting, documentation, disbursement, and repayment. Along with lending services, Vaibhav Vyapaar also earns revenue by offering application and technology services to other NBFCs. Its main target audiences are retail borrowers, including first-time borrowers and lower-income salaried professionals across urban and semi-urban regions of India.
